_about: Public network identity for the FLOP networks, read from official pages on 26 November 2026: flop.network/llms.txt, docs.flop.network/networks/testnet, faucet /chain endpoints, github.com/flop-labs/network networks/testnet.md. The genesis hash is checked against the live RPC on every run; a mismatch stops the kit.

devnet.label: FLOP Devnet
devnet.earns: nothing. Devnet activity does not count and does not carry over to testnet.

testnet.label: FLOP Testnet
testnet.earns: nothing before the publicly announced activation block, which has not been announced. Earlier activity earns zero, with no backfill (Testnet FAQ, 24 November 2026).
